records.title: スタディ§ステディ体験版
records.titleKana: すたでぃすてでぃ
constraints: Smooth rendering depends on a title profile that routes Direct3D 9 to DXVK. On Wine's default Direct3D 9 (wined3d over macOS OpenGL), the 32-bit buffer mapping path slowed Live2D/Emote scenes to about 3-11 fps.
The title profile ships in KASANE 1.0.12 (21) and later.
records.evidenceSummary: Main story, save/load, save thumbnails, and the opening PV were confirmed with Direct3D 9 on DXVK at about 60 fps; KASANE 1.0.12 (21) then applied the title profile on a reset prefix, loaded DXVK, and ran at about 63 fps. Binary imports include both D3D9 and OpenGL, but the game presents through D3D9 only.

records.titleKana: かのじょすてっぷ
records.edition: メガストア2026年12月号付録（完全収録）
constraints: Sprite rendering depends on a title profile that reports four processors to the game; with the host's full core count, sprite pixels were intermittently left unwritten and the background showed through.
Whether the same behavior occurs on many-core Windows PCs has not been checked.
records.evidenceSummary: Installer flow from the appendix DVD, title screen, prologue, opening movie, audio, save/load, and save thumbnails were confirmed in installed Release 1.0.10 (19) with the processor-count profile applied.

records.title: カタネガイ体験版
records.titleKana: かたねがい
constraints: The engine renders through bundled ANGLE, which only tries Direct3D 11; Wine's default Direct3D 11 on macOS OpenGL offers no usable feature level, so the title profile routes Direct3D 11 to DXVK.
Movies are WebM files played by the game's own FFmpeg, not by Wine's media stack.
records.evidenceSummary: Installer flow, title, main story, save/load, thumbnails, audio, opening movies, completion of the trial, and exit were confirmed with Direct3D 11 on DXVK; installed Release 1.0.11 (20) was then confirmed to apply the title profile on a reset prefix and reach the title screen.
